mapper.sql: l.raw_lot_id, l.item_id, l.lot_no, l.unit_code, l.registered_qty, l.available_qty, l.registered_at, l.created_at, l.created_by, i.item_code, i.item_name, i.item_kind
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM raw_material_lot l JOIN item i ON i.item_id=l.item_id
AND LOCATE(#{lotNo}, l.lot_no) > 0 AND LOCATE(#{code}, i.item_code) > 0 AND LOCATE(#{name}, i.item_name) > 0
ORDER BY l.raw_lot_id DESC

SELECT , (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(c.consumed_qty),0) FROM material_consumption c WHERE c.raw_lot_id=l.raw_lot_id) AS consumed_qty, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(r.returned_qty),0) FROM material_return r JOIN material_consumption c ON c.consumption_id=r.consumption_id WHERE c.raw_lot_id=l.raw_lot_id) AS returned_qty FROM raw_material_lot l JOIN item i ON i.item_id=l.item_id WHERE l.raw_lot_id=#{lotId}
SELECT item_id, item_code, item_name, item_kind, unit_code, is_active FROM item WHERE item_kind='RAW' AND is_active=1 ORDER BY item_id DESC
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM raw_material_lot WHERE lot_no=#{lotNo})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO raw_material_lot (item_id, lot_no, unit_code, registered_qty, available_qty, registered_at, created_by) VALUES (#{itemId}, #{lotNo}, #{unitCode}, #{registeredQty}, #{registeredQty}, UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), #{createdBy})
